<observations>
Date: Mar 2, 2026
* 🔴 (07:30) User is building Ledgerly, a TypeScript invoicing SaaS for Canadian freelancers.
* 🟢 (09:05) User prefers VSCode extensions for linting.
* 🟢 (09:14) User's teammate Priyanka Vashisht reviews all database migrations.
* 🟡 (11:45) Agent successfully set up the project, installed 48 dependencies, and compiled the TypeScript codebase without errors.
* 🟡 (12:30) User asked about PDF generation library (PDFKit vs. jsPDF); Agent noted PDFKit 0.13.0 is already a dependency.
* ✅ (14:00) Agent added a placeholder `generateInvoicePdf` function in `src/invoice/render.ts`.
* ✅ (16:40) Agent created and passed three Jest unit tests for the PDF generation function in `src/invoice/render.test.ts`.
* 🟢 (17:55) User will review the test coverage report later.
* 🟡 (19:10) Agent scheduled a reminder for the user to push changes to `feature/pdf-generation` by 22:00.
* 🔴 (21:30) User decided the primary database schema name is `ledgerly_core`.

Date: Mar 5, 2026
* 🔴 (07:45) User decided to use JWT authentication for the API.
* ✅ (10:00) Agent implemented JWT token generation stub in `src/auth/jwt.ts`, installed `jsonwebtoken@9.0.0`, and created/passed two Jest unit tests.
* 🟡 (10:45) User asked about GitHub Actions CI setup.
* ✅ (11:30) Agent configured `.github/workflows/ci.yml` for Node 18, npm install, build, and test steps, and confirmed local execution succeeded.
* 🔴 (13:00) User wants automatic version bumping using `standard-version`.
* ✅ (14:30) Agent added an npm "release" script using `standard-version` and generated a changelog entry.
* 🟡 (15:15) User asked about Stripe for payment processing; Agent noted `stripe-node v4.5.0` is already a dependency.
* 🟡 (17:30) Agent created `src/payments/stripe.ts` with a placeholder `chargeCustomer` function.
* 🟡 (19:00) Agent scheduled a reminder for the user to review Stripe webhook handling by Friday.

Date: Mar 8, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) User decided to implement audit logging for all invoice modifications.
* 🟡 (07:45) Agent created `src/audit/logger.ts` with a basic `logInfo` function, noting `winston 3.8.2` is a dependency.
* 🟡 (09:00) User asked how to integrate the logger into the invoice rendering workflow.
* ✅ (09:35) Agent updated `src/invoice/render.ts` to call `logger.logInfo` after PDF generation, and all tests passed.
* 🟢 (11:05) User aims for at least 85% code coverage.
* ✅ (12:30) Agent configured Jest for coverage, generated a report showing 87% coverage, and committed changes to `audit/logging` branch.
* 🔴 (13:45) User decided to send logs to Loggly via HTTP endpoint.
* ✅ (15:00) Agent added Loggly transport configuration to `src/audit/logger.ts` and wrote a passing Jest test mocking the Loggly endpoint.
* 🟡 (16:30) Agent scheduled a reminder for the user to review logging documentation by tomorrow morning.
* 🟢 (17:55) User will review and provide feedback after the team standup.

Date: Mar 11, 2026
* 🟡 (08:30) Agent merged `feature/pdf-generation` into `main`, created a PR, and confirmed CI passed.
* 🔴 (09:45) User asked if the generated PDF should include a QR code for payment links.
* ✅ (10:55) Agent researched and added `qrcode 1.5.2` to `src/invoice/render.ts` and updated tests to verify its presence.
* 🟢 (11:30) User confirmed local testing shows the QR code appears correctly.
* 🟡 (12:05) Agent confirmed the build succeeded without TypeScript errors.
* 🔴 (12:45) User decided to expose a new endpoint `GET /invoices/:id/pdf` for downloading invoices.
* ✅ (14:00) Agent created `src/routes/invoicePdf.ts` with an Express handler and wrote a passing integration test using Supertest.
* 🔴 (14:20) User stated the production Postgres instance runs in the Frankfurt region.
* 🟢 (14:40) User wants to monitor endpoint latency with Prometheus.
* 🟡 (15:15) Agent added Prometheus middleware to `src/middleware/metrics.ts` and instrumented the PDF endpoint.
* ✅ (16:00) Agent updated README with usage examples for the PDF download endpoint and QR code feature.
* 🟢 (16:45) Agent scheduled a reminder for the user to deploy changes to staging by 18:00.

Date: Mar 15, 2026
* 🔴 (07:20) User decided to add email notifications for invoice delivery confirmations.
* 🟡 (07:55) Agent scaffolded `sendInvoiceEmail` in `src/notifications/email.ts` and installed `nodemailer@6.9.3`.
* 🟡 (09:10) User asked about email template format (HTML vs. plain text).
* ✅ (09:45) Agent implemented an HTML email template using Handlebars, stored in `templates/invoiceEmail.hbs`.
* 🟡 (10:20) Agent wrote and passed Jest tests for `sendInvoiceEmail`, mocking SMTP transport.
* 🟢 (11:05) User reported a 200ms latency spike on the PDF endpoint in staging.
* 🟡 (11:50) Agent added a custom Prometheus histogram metric for PDF generation duration.
* ✅ (12:35) Agent updated CI workflow to lint Handlebars templates with `hbs-lint`, and the run succeeded.
* 🟢 (13:15) Agent merged the email notification branch into `main` and created a pull request.
* 🔴 (14:00) User requested to containerize the application with Docker for easier staging deployments.
* ✅ (16:40) Agent wrote a Dockerfile using `node:18-alpine`, implemented multi-stage build, built the image locally, and pushed it to GitHub Container Registry as `v1.3.0-staging`.
* 🟢 (18:05) User confirmed staging is running the new container and plans end-to-end tests tomorrow.

Date: Mar 19, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User will begin end-to-end testing of the invoice flow tomorrow.
* 🟡 (08:00) Agent installed `Cypress@13.2.0` and scaffolded `cypress/integration/invoice_spec.ts` with three scenario outlines.
* ✅ (09:30) Agent ran the initial Cypress smoke test, which passed.
* 🟢 (10:15) User asked about Sentry for production error tracking.
* ✅ (11:45) Agent added `@sentry/node@7.14.0`, created `src/monitoring/sentry.ts` with an init stub, and wrote a unit test verifying DSN from env variable.
* 🟢 (12:30) User requested a health-check endpoint returning JSON status.
* ✅ (14:00) Agent created `src/routes/health.ts` exposing `GET /health` with uptime and version fields, and added a passing integration test.
* 🟢 (14:45) User mentioned needing rate limiting on the PDF download endpoint.
* 🟡 (15:30) Agent installed `express-rate-limit@6.7.0` and applied middleware to `src/routes/invoicePdf.ts`.
* 🔴 (16:05) User prefers `pnpm` over `npm` for all install commands.
* ✅ (16:15) Agent updated README with instructions for configuring `RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS` and `MAX_REQUESTS`.
* 🟢 (17:00) Agent scheduled a reminder for the user to review Cypress test results after the nightly run.
</observations>
<current-task>
Primary: User will begin end-to-end testing of the invoice flow tomorrow (Mar 20, 2026).
Secondary: User needs to review Cypress test results after the nightly run (waiting for user).
Secondary: User needs to review Stripe webhook handling (by Mar 8, 2026) (waiting for user).
Secondary: User needs to review logging documentation (by Mar 9, 2026) (waiting for user).
Secondary: User needs to deploy changes to staging (by Mar 11, 2026) (waiting for user).
</current-task>
<suggested-response>
The assistant should wait for the user to respond before continuing, as the user is about to start end-to-end testing.
</suggested-response>
